newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston Q1 net per share rises.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston Q1 net per share rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Full name of company is Bank of Boston Corp.
Excluding special items from sale of mortgage banking subsidiary, Q1 1996 net was $1.13 per share.
On fully taxable equivalent basis, Q1 1997 operating income was $413 million vs $381 million for Q1 1996.
Return on average common equity was 18.02 percent for Q1 1997 vs 16.96 percent for Q1 1996.
Return on average assets was 1.33 percent for Q1 1997 vs 1.28 percent for Q1 1996.
Net interest margin for Q1 1997 was 4.47 percent for Q1 1997 vs 4.40 percent for Q1 1996.
First Call estimate for Q1 1997 net income was $1.28 per share.
